description:
Jopet Mining & Civil PNG Limited
Job Opportunity: Diesel Fitters
Location:
Port Moresby
Company:
Jopet Mining & Civil PNG Limited
About Us:
Jopet Mining & Civil PNG Limited is a trusted provider of plant hire and maintenance services supporting the Mining, Oil & Gas, Quarrying and Marine industries throughout Papua New Guinea. We specialise in earthmoving machinery maintenance, field service, workshop repairs and component rebuilds ensuring reliability and performance across all operations.
About the Role:
We are currently seeking qualified and experienced Diesel Fitters to join our growing team. This role involves the maintenance, repair and overhaul of heavy earthmoving machinery and equipment both in the workshop and in the field.
Key Responsibilities:
Carry out diagnostics, servicing and repairs on a range of heavy equipment and vehicles.
Perform component rebuilds and preventative maintenance.
Work on plant and machinery for mining, civil, marine, and quarry operations.
Ensure all work is completed safely and to a high standard.
Maintain accurate service and maintenance records.
Requirements:
National Trade Certificate (NTC Level 3 or higher) in Diesel Fitting, Heavy Equipment Maintenance or a recognised equivalent qualification.
Experience working on earthmoving, heavy vehicle or marine equipment.
Strong mechanical and diagnostic skills.
Commitment to workplace safety and teamwork.
Own tooling is preferred but not essential.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary and conditions.
Opportunity to work with a professional and safety focused team.
Long term employment and career development opportunities.
Exposure to a wide range of machinery and projects across industries.
OEM Training provided to suitable candidates.
